note: WAEC Civic round 5 (R27 top-up): tax and anthem duties, NYSC as national service; citizenship by registration, naturalisation requirements, loss by foreign allegiance; assent, two-thirds veto override, committee stage, recall; election petition tribunals, Boundary Commission vs INEC, party registration spread; federal character, quota, ethnic suspicion; flag's green, horses and eagle of the coat of arms, Niger and Benue bands, NYSC's post-war purpose, FRSC; EFCC vs ICPC mandates, Code of Conduct Bureau assets; contentment, integrity, discipline; representative democracy, free and fair elections, tyranny of the majority; UDHR 1948, rights limitation, Chapter IV. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-4, NECO Civic (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
